chunk_findings.detail: The diff removes `program git` baselines for `ddflow/api/pin_files.py`, `ddflow/services/bug_globs.py`, and `ddflow/services/file_size.py`, but the stated shrunk interface entries list only `ddflow/services/metrics/lockgit.py` as having shrunk. If any of those three modules still contains its prior single `git` invocation, the arch-interfaces ratchet now sees current count `1` against baseline `0` and fails; if they no longer do, the change is lowering baselines outside the declared family, so the stated regression scope no longer matches what is actually being locked down.
chunk_findings.title: tests/arch_baselines/arch_interfaces.txt

chunk_findings.detail: The only clock-env baseline changed is `ddflow/services/pins.py` from `11` to `9`, while the stated clock-env shrinks are in `adapters.mcp`, `infra.threads`, `services.inbox`, and `review.model`. Given the manifest contains no source changes for `pins.py`, lowering its baseline to `9` will fail the clock-env ratchet if `pins.py` still has `11` direct clock uses; and because none of the four named clock-env files is updated, the claimed shrinks are not actually ratcheted, so a new clock use in `review/model.py` could grow back toward its old baseline without being caught.
